personality_one_liner: A high-performance, command-center interface designed for rapid technical data entry, live monitoring, and IT documentation.

spacing.rule: Dense information architecture. Use 1px borders and sharp dividers instead of spacing for section separation. Minimize empty space to maximize data density.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and surfaceTertiary to indicate elevation.
dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism. It degrades readability in high-density technical dashboards.

screens.name: Login

states.loading: Amber spinner over dark technical background.
states.error: Red error text below input fields.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image of dark server rack with vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface). Form container at bottom 40%: Email/Pass inputs with sharp borders, Google Auth button, primary Login CTA.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level overview of quotes, active clients, and server status.

states.loading: Skeleton blocks matching the metric grid.
states.empty: No active data. Display prompt to create a Quote.
states.error: Failed to fetch dashboard data. Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky header with user profile. Horizontal scroll row of oversized metric cards (Rajdhani font) for Quotes Pending, Offline Servers (Red accent). 2-column grid of quick actions below. Recent Activity feed at bottom.

screens.name: Quotes
screens.purpose: Manage and export commercial and technical quotes.

states.empty: Illustration of empty folder. Primary CTA: 'Nova Cotação'.
states.error: Failed to load quotes. Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Top segmented control (Pending, Approved, Draft). List view of quotes. Each card shows Client, Value, and Status badge. Tap opens detail view: line items list, bottom sticky container with 'Edit PDF' and 'Export/Print' buttons.

screens.name: RackBuilder
screens.purpose: Visual representation of up to 50U IT racks.
screens.layout: Vertical FlatList of 50 rows. Each row is 1U. Tap a slot to open a bottom sheet component picker (Switch, Server, Blank, Cable Guide). Filled slots show hardware icon, name, and take up multiple U's if required. Strict borders between U's.

screens.name: NetworkTopology
screens.purpose: Packet Tracer-style network diagram and floor plan mapper.

states.empty: Prompt: 'Upload Floor Plan or Start Diagram'.

screens.layout: Pinch-to-zoom SVG/Canvas area. Floating action button for adding nodes (Router, Switch, PC). Tap a node to open bottom sheet for configuring IP/Ports and assigning links. Sticky bottom bar for PDF export.

screens.name: ServerMap
screens.purpose: Geographical overview of managed servers across Brazil.
screens.layout: Full-screen vector map of Brazil. Absolute positioned pulsing dots (Green = Online, Red = Offline). Tapping a dot pulls up a Gorhom bottom sheet showing Server IP, Domain, Specs (masked by default, tap to reveal) and connection tree.

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply Personality 7: Dark-First Utility DARK strictly. Avoid any soft, playful, or glassmorphic elements. The interface should feel like high-end IT monitoring software (e.g. Datadog, AWS, UniFi).
BANNED COLORS: Blue, Indigo, Purple, Navy. Use the defined Amber (#FF8A00) for primary actions, keeping the aesthetic industrial and tactical.

For the Rack Builder: Do not implement complex drag-and-drop. Use a tap-to-select flow where tapping an empty 'U' slot opens a Gorhom bottom sheet to pick the hardware component, which is a much more stable mobile pattern.
For the Network Topology: Ensure pinch-to-zoom is available on the diagram, and keep touch targets to a minimum of 44x44pt. Use bottom sheets for port-mapping rather than tapping tiny lines.
Data privacy: IP addresses, domains, and ports in the Server Map bottom sheet must have a secure 'tap-to-reveal' state to prevent shoulder surfing.
PDF Generation: Ensure the sticky 'Export/Print' button is always anchored above the safe area on Quotes and Topology screens, unaffected by the scroll view.
